design_principle: High time pressure combined with relaxed success thresholds to break hovering local optimum. State-based success detection ensures reward signal aligns with physical landing behavior.

iteration_policy.iter4_principle: High time pressure (-0.5/step) forces agent to prioritize landing over survival, breaking the hovering local optimum.
